attchmntText: Mcleod Russel India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: McLeod Russel India Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The advertisement was published on 15th November 2026 in Financial Express and Aajkaal. The Board of Directors approved the financial results on 14th November 2026. Standalone total income from operations was 47,696.37 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Standalone net profit after tax was 28,076.27 lakhs. Consolidated total income from operations was 60,020.04 lakhs. Consolidated net profit after tax was 10,125.16 lakhs. Earnings per share for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was 9.98 rupees on a basic basis. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

attchmntText: Mcleod Russel India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Revised Outcome of Board Meeting dated 14th November, 2026 '.
voiceSummary: McLeod Russel India Limited filed a revised outcome of its Board Meeting held on 14th November, 2026, to correct a typographical error in the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The company stated the correction is clerical and does not impact financial figures or profitability. Independent auditors Lodha & Co issued an adverse review report on the financial results. The auditors cited significant uncertainties regarding the recoverability of Inter Corporate Deposits aggregating Rs. 2,86,050 lakhs, with Rs. 41,421 lakhs remaining unprovided. Other issues included non-determination of fair values for assets, lease rents, and statutory liabilities, as well as non-recognition of interest on loans. The report highlighted a going concern assumption due to current liabilities exceeding current assets and operational losses affecting net worth. Borrowings have been restructured subject to conditions precedent, and the company's ability to continue depends on fulfilling these conditions and asset monetization.

attchmntText: Mcleod Russel India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: McLeod Russel India Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The Statutory Auditors, M/s. Lodha & Co. LLP, issued an adverse conclusion. The auditors stated the financial results have not been prepared fairly in all material respects. Key issues include Inter Corporate Deposits aggregating to Rs. 2,86,050 lakhs given to promoter group entities, which are doubtful of recovery. A provision of Rs. 2,44,629 lakhs was made earlier, leaving a balance of Rs. 41,421 lakhs unprovided. The auditors noted that profit for the period is overstated to this extent. Other matters include non-recognition of interest on loans, non-determination of fair value of assets, and pending statutory liabilities. The financial results were prepared on a going concern basis, assuming fulfillment of conditions precedent for restructured borrowings and debt settlement proposals.
